question: Who was behind publishing the first News Paper in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**James Augustus Hickey.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first newspaper in India,** "The Bengal Gazette," **was **established by James Augustus Hickey.**
 
• James Augustus Hickey was **an Irishman** who started the newspaper **in 1780** during the colonial period.
 
• "The Bengal Gazette" is also known as the **Calcutta General Advertiser.**
 
• This newspaper marked a significant milestone in Indian media history, becoming the **pioneer of journalism in the country.**
 
• James Hickey's initiative laid the** foundation **for the development and growth of the press in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deen Bandhu Mitra:**

 
 
• Deen Bandhu Mitra was a **Bengali playwright, poet, and journalist **during the **19th century.**
 
• He is best known for his play** "Nil Darpan," **which highlighted the **oppression faced by indigo farmers under British rule.**
 
• Deen Bandhu Mitra made significant contributions to** Bengali literature and social issues.**
 
 
 
• **Hem Chandrakar:**
 
 
• Hem Chandrakar was an Indian **social worker and a prominent figure **in the tribal and rural development movement.
 
• He worked towards the **welfare and upliftment of tribal communities,** focusing on education and empowerment.
 
• However, Hem Chandrakar was not associated with the publication of the first newspaper in India.
 
 
 
• **Harishchandra Mukherjee:**
 
 
• Harishchandra Mukherjee was an **influential journalist and reformer** in 19th-century India.
 
• He was the editor of** "Hindu Patriot,"** a newspaper that was instrumental in promoting the Indian nationalistic sentiment during the British Raj.
 
• Mukherjee was also heavily involved in **social reform, contributing notably to the cause of widow remarriages in India.**
 
• He was a** supportive voice for the Indian Rebellion of 1857** through his writings in the Hindu Patriot.
